senses.gloss: Īśa^1 (“the Lord”) = Brahmán: I, 2499; VI, †1261 (Bº); XII, 11094 (Bº).
Īśa^3 (do.) = Vishṇu (Nārāyaṇa, Kṛshṇa): XII, 11120 (Nārāyaṇe), 12700, 13249 (aham Īśaḥ, says Kṛshṇa), 13285, 13318, 13556 (Nārāyaṇena); XVI, 132.
Īśa^4 (do.), the Supreme Being, in general: V, †1764.

Īśāna^2 (do.) = Śiva: III, 8169 (worshipped in Gokarṇa), 8836 (Śaṅkaraṃ Bhavaṃ), 9953, 15887 (friend of Kubera); VII, 2863, 2876, 5144 (Brahmeºendra-Varuṇān), 9453, 9462, 9503, 9504, 9534, 9595; VIII, 628 (Brahmeºāv iva), 1435 (Sthāṇuṃ), 1489, 1531, 1665, 2161 (Brahmeºendra-Varuṇān), 4361, 4440 (Brahmeºau), 4456 (Brahmeºānuśāsanaṃ); IX, 908; X, 252; XII, 4498 (Rudrānāṃ…goptāraṃ), 10141, 10330, 10390 (1000 names^1), 13152, 13292; XIII, 658, 728, 828, 908, 924, 956, 998, 1015, 1042, 1103, 1188 (1000 names^2), 1273, 1305, 1331, 1359, 7497; XIV, 208.
Īśāna^3 (do.) = Vishṇu (Nārāyaṇa, Kṛshṇa): I, 22; XII, 12903 (in the form of Aniruddha), 12982, 13063, 13226, 13480, 13695; XIII, 6957 (1000 names); XIV, 1088 (= mahān ātmā).
Īśāna^4 (do.) = the Supreme Being, in general: III, 1139: V, 917, 1751; XII, 11692.
